name: Kelpie
source: An impolite and arrogant water horse who follows Lydia all the way to London to bring her back to Scotland. Despite his aggressiveness, Kelpie genuinely loves and cares for Lydia, and comforts her when she's confused.His true form is that of a black horse and he has relatively strong magical powers.
